# `silk/url/percent`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Percent-encode and percent-decode text with the encode sets of the WHATWG URL Standard.

## When to use
Use [`UrlPercent`](#UrlPercent) to build a component of a URL for a browser-compatible URL, or to read
`application/x-www-form-urlencoded` text. For RFC 3986 URIs, use `silk.uri.percent`.

## Details
Encoding works on UTF-8 bytes. Each byte that is in the selected [`UrlEncodeSet`](#UrlEncodeSet) becomes
`%XX` with uppercase hexadecimal digits; bytes 0x80 and above are in every set. Decoding is
lenient, as the URL Standard specifies: a `%` that does not start a valid escape stays as it
is.

## Examples
### Encode a query value
```silk
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.collections.bytes { Bytes }
import silk.text.string { String }
import silk.url.percent { UrlEncodeSet, UrlPercent }

pub effect fn main() -> i32
  ! OutOfMemoryError {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  let mut output = Bytes.make()
  run UrlPercent.appendEncoded(&mut output, String.utf8Bytes("a b&c"), UrlEncodeSet.Component)
    |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
  if Bytes.asSlice(&output) != b"a%20b%26c" {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

Import as `UrlPercent` with `import silk.url.percent { UrlPercent }`.

## `UrlEncodeSet`

```silk
pub enum UrlEncodeSet
```

A percent-encode set of the URL Standard. Each set holds the bytes that become `%XX`.

### Details
Every set holds the C0 controls (0x00 to 0x1F) and the bytes 0x7F and above. Each set after
`C0Control` holds the bytes of the set before it, except `FormUrlencoded`, which holds those of
`Component`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.C0Control"></a>

### `C0Control`

```silk
C0Control
```

The C0 control percent-encode set: only the C0 controls and 0x7F and above.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.Fragment"></a>

### `Fragment`

```silk
Fragment
```

The fragment set: adds space, `"`, `<`, `>`, and `` ` ``.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.Query"></a>

### `Query`

```silk
Query
```

The query set: adds space, `"`, `#`, `<`, and `>` to `C0Control`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.SpecialQuery"></a>

### `SpecialQuery`

```silk
SpecialQuery
```

The special-query set, for the query of a special URL: adds `'` to `Query`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.Path"></a>

### `Path`

```silk
Path
```

The path set: adds `?`, `^`, `` ` ``, `{`, and `}` to `Query`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.Userinfo"></a>

### `Userinfo`

```silk
Userinfo
```

The userinfo set: adds `/`, `:`, `;`, `=`, `@`, `[` to `^`, and `|` to `Path`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.Component"></a>

### `Component`

```silk
Component
```

The component set: adds `$`, `%`, `&`, `+`, and `,` to `Userinfo`. It encodes `%`.

<a id="UrlEncodeSet.FormUrlencoded"></a>

### `FormUrlencoded`

```silk
FormUrlencoded
```

The `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` set: adds `!`, `'` to `)`, and `~` to `Component`.
Space is encoded as `+` when the caller asks for it.

<a id="UrlPercent.impl.appendEncoded"></a>

### Associated function `appendEncoded`

```silk
pub effect fn appendEncoded(output: &mut Bytes, values: &[u8], set: UrlEncodeSet) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends `values` encoded with `set` to `output`.

#### Details
A `%` in `values` stays as it is in every set except `Component` and `FormUrlencoded`, so text
that is already encoded does not change in the other sets.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="UrlPercent.impl.appendFormEncoded"></a>

### Associated function `appendFormEncoded`

```silk
pub effect fn appendFormEncoded(output: &mut Bytes, values: &[u8], set: UrlEncodeSet) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends `values` encoded with `set` to `output`, and writes each space as `+`.

#### Details
It is the `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` serializer's encoding of a name or a value when
`set` is `FormUrlencoded`.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="UrlPercent.impl.appendDecoded"></a>

### Associated function `appendDecoded`

```silk
pub effect fn appendDecoded(output: &mut Bytes, values: &[u8], plusIsSpace: bool) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends the bytes of `values` with each valid `%XX` escape decoded to `output`.

#### Details
A `%` that is not followed by two hexadecimal digits stays as it is. When `plusIsSpace` is
`true`, each `+` becomes a space first, as form decoding does. The result is not always valid
UTF-8.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="UrlPercent.impl.appendDecodedText"></a>

### Associated function `appendDecodedText`

```silk
pub effect fn appendDecodedText(output: &mut String, values: &[u8], plusIsSpace: bool) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends the text of `values` to `output`: the percent-decoded bytes, read as UTF-8.

#### Details
It is the URL Standard's percent-decode followed by UTF-8 decode without BOM. Each invalid
UTF-8 sequence becomes U+FFFD, and a leading byte order mark stays. When `plusIsSpace` is
`true`, each `+` becomes a space first, as form decoding does.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.

<a id="UrlPercent.impl.appendUtf8Lossy"></a>

### Associated function `appendUtf8Lossy`

```silk
pub effect fn appendUtf8Lossy(output: &mut String, values: &[u8]) -> ()
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Appends `values` read as UTF-8 to `output`, with each invalid sequence replaced by U+FFFD.

#### Details
It is the Encoding Standard's UTF-8 decode without BOM: a maximal invalid subpart becomes one
U+FFFD, and a leading byte order mark stays.

#### Errors
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` fails.
